reason: The picture shows muscle-development messengers reaching target cells and activating muscle genes, so I’ll start the muscle-cell pathway.
expectation: Some cells will develop toward muscle and become ready to make pulling proteins.

alternatives.reason: The other messengers appear to start the supporting-fibre pathway instead.

effect: The messengers produced muscle precursor cells with muscle-protein instructions active; their fibres still need to be made.
reaction: The definition of precursor makes the next stage clearer.
reason: Amino acids are protein building blocks, and the muscle precursor cells have instructions for proteins to make.
expectation: The cells will use the amino acids to make muscle proteins.

alternatives.reason: I could start the supporting-cell pathway first instead.

effect: The muscle precursors now contain pulling proteins, completing the muscle goal. The other goal is to build supporting fibres.
reaction: The sliding fibres make their pulling job clearer.
reason: The supporting-cell messengers are shown activating support-protein genes in the unspecialized cells.
expectation: Some cells will become precursors that can make supporting fibres.

effect: The supporting messengers produced fibre-producing cells with support-protein instructions active, but the fibre network has not formed yet.
reaction: The parallel with the muscle pathway makes the next step clearer.
reason: Amino acids are protein building blocks, and these cells have instructions for support proteins.
expectation: The cells will make supporting protein fibres around themselves.

effect: The fibre-producing cells made supporting connective tissue around themselves, completing the second goal. Unlike the muscle cells, they released protein into their surroundings.
reaction: The contrast between proteins inside and outside cells made the two pathways clearer.

mostWorthwhile.text: Making the pulling proteins was worthwhile because the sliding fibres showed how the proteins relate to the muscle cells’ job.

leastWorthwhile.text: The supporting pathway felt a little repetitive after the muscle pathway, though the result showed a useful difference.

surprise.text: I was surprised that cells with the same DNA could make proteins for such different jobs, including material outside the cells.

arbitrary.text: Nothing felt especially arbitrary: the messenger pictures and the earlier protein-building example made the pairings understandable.

continue.text: I would choose to continue, because the result hints at a later muscle chapter and I’d like to see how these separate cells become larger fibres.
